name: Azeroth Companion
title: ADVENTURE INTELLIGENCE — Expedition Console & World Atlas Overdrive
approval_note: Owner authorized the v16.5 development and publication. Synthetic Chromium/WebKit acceptance is separate from physical iPhone and real in-game player verification.
features: Expedition Console: cinematic mission briefing studio with activity-based preparation checklists, private notes and manual progress.
Mission intelligence: pin and prioritize your own goals, search by mission/character/status, customize steps and export safe JSON briefs.
World Atlas Overdrive: bookmark destinations, visualize your own regional mission counts and open one-click Prepare Mission links.
Living War Room: next-expedition pulse, manual checklist percentage and saved destination shortcuts inside the existing cinematic homepage.
Connected characters, Talent Forge drafts and Item Atlas IDs are labeled as local records with warnings when a link is no longer present.
Original Blizzard login, spell icons, Forge engine, Character Nexus, music, saved records and Discord automation are preserved.
v16.5 synthetic desktop/iPhone browser flows passed. Owner-approved release with live-player and physical-device acceptance pending.
